name: Kangoku Senkan 2 ~Yousai Toshi no Sennou Kaizou~
original_name: 監獄戦艦2～要塞都市の洗脳改造～
source:
In the solar system, there is a cold war going between Neo Terrors (Group of the Earth) and New Soral (Group of space colonies).
There is a neutral third party known for its strong military power: Cordelia is a fortified city which is constructed on a secondary planet of the Uranus. There, renowned general Alicia Viewstream and the imperial heir Maya Cordelia decided to build an alliance with the New Solar.

The main character, Dino Dirasso, is a secret agent sent from Neo Terrors. His plan to prevent the alliance was radical: making use of the secret brainwashing lab in the new battleship called Yekel, he starts the brainwashing modification and personality destroying training of the two women!

[From [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE064478.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
太陽系中，Neo Terrors（地球集團）與New Solar（宇宙殖民地集團）正處於冷戰狀態。
另有一個以雄厚軍力聞名的第三方中立勢力：Cordelia。這是一座建造在天王星某顆衛星上的要塞都市。著名將軍Alicia Viewstream與帝國繼承人Maya Cordelia決定同New Solar結盟。

主角Dino Dirasso是Neo Terrors派出的潛伏的特務。為了阻止結盟，他決定採取激烈手段：利用新戰艦Yekel內的秘密洗腦實驗室，對兩名成年女性實施洗腦改造和摧毀人格的訓練！
